description: This file defines a React component for the user settings general tab in Mattermost, handling user profile updates such as username, email, name, profile picture, and custom attributes.

classes.name: UserSettingsGeneralTab
classes.description: React component class for the user settings general tab, managing user profile updates and interactions.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state based on user props.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches custom profile attributes if enabled and not already loaded.

methods.name: handleEmailResend
methods.description: Handles resending verification email and updates resend status.

methods.name: createEmailResendLink
methods.description: Creates a UI link for resending email verification.

methods.name: submitUsername
methods.description: Submits updated username if changed.

methods.name: submitNickname
methods.description: Submits updated nickname if changed.

methods.name: submitName
methods.description: Submits updated first and last name.

methods.name: submitEmail
methods.description: Submits updated email after validation.

methods.name: isEmailValid
methods.description: Validates email format and confirmation.

methods.name: submitUser
methods.description: Sends user data to update profile, handles email verification logic.

methods.name: setDefaultProfilePicture
methods.description: Resets profile picture to default.

methods.name: submitPicture
methods.description: Uploads new profile picture after validation.

methods.name: submitPosition
methods.description: Submits updated position.

methods.name: submitAttribute
methods.description: Saves custom profile attribute after validation.

methods.name: updateUsername
methods.description: Updates username state from input.

methods.name: updateFirstName
methods.description: Updates first name state from input.

methods.name: updateLastName
methods.description: Updates last name state from input.

methods.name: updateNickname
methods.description: Updates nickname state from input.

methods.name: updatePosition
methods.description: Updates position state from input.

methods.name: updateEmail
methods.description: Updates email state from input.

methods.name: updateConfirmEmail
methods.description: Updates confirm email state from input.

methods.name: updateCurrentPassword
methods.description: Updates current password state from input.

methods.name: updatePicture
methods.description: Handles profile picture file selection.

methods.name: updateSelectAttribute
methods.description: Updates custom attribute values from select input.

methods.name: updateAttribute
methods.description: Updates custom attribute values from text input.

methods.name: updateSection
methods.description: Resets state and updates active section.

methods.name: setupInitialState
methods.description: Initializes component state from user props.

methods.name: createEmailSection
methods.description: Renders email update section with validation and help text.

methods.name: createCustomAttributeSection
methods.description: Renders custom profile attribute sections, including editing and display logic.

methods.name: createPictureSection
methods.description: Renders profile picture upload and display section.

methods.name: renderPictureStatus
methods.description: Displays current picture upload status.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the entire user settings general tab UI, including all sections.
